note: Proposed replacements for the unmeasured grey and black gates in data/progress/belt-gates.json, and optional extra gates for orange..brown. minWpm is correct words per minute, self-reported. Targets come from data/curriculum/belts.json wpmTarget, which is ALEF's own proposal, not sourced. Nothing here says a learner 'is' a belt.

grey.label: Timed read-aloud of one text, 3 reads, about 70 words a minute (self-reported)

black.label: Timed read-aloud of one longer text, 3 reads, about 80 words a minute (self-reported)
